decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings are a core, compatible component of the firm's drainage families, and such long-cycle sanitary products are rarely withdrawn within a few years.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's accessible, low-profile strategy and fits growing renovation demand.
The designer shower drain is the firm's flagship and embodies its design-focused direction, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The shower element with integrated slope supports integrated floor-level showers, though its lower visibility makes it somewhat more exposed to range consolidation.
The DallSafe backflow-protected basement drain meets a durable niche need, and its rising relevance given heavy-rain events supports keeping it.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral complementary item that rounds out the installer range at low cost, so it is likely kept despite not being a focus.
